The plume of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The oasis is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the gale. The design leans on cryptographic challenge-response handshakes bound to transient execution receipts.
